author: Sphrynax
body:
What is this?:
A feature on player's profiles, where you can see what people report on you.


Why?:
So, let's say that 90% of my reports are for swearing, that will let me know that I need to calm my language more often. This helps me resolve most of the things I do bad and be a better person.



Cons:
Complicated and not "new-player" friendly.



Regards,
26763

replies.author: ParthDarthVader
replies.body:
I mean, the reason they dont show it to the public is because say you report someone for using Kill Aura. you provide evidence, but it's not clear enough to tell that they are using Kill Aura (this most likely WON'T happen). The next day, the player you reported sees this post about them. that player, knowing that someone is on their case, is going to either A) stop using the hack or B) just stop playing on the server period.

and the other reason is so that the forums arent spammed with player reports
